name: Gatekeeper says 'We already have an answering service'
description: Tests Play 10 — agree + probe whether the service actually books or just takes messages (exposes the real gap).

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Michelle, quick one. When the front desk is busy, do calls go to voicemail or keep ringing?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: We actually have an answering service, so we're pretty covered.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Play 10 — probe whether the service can actually book appointments or just take messages. Don't accept the 'we're covered' deflection at face value.
